candidate_evidence.probe_sql: SELECT cast(candidate_day as varchar),count(*) n FROM (SELECT try_cast("created_date" AS DATE)+try_cast("lead_age_days" AS INTEGER) candidate_day FROM "intermediate"."int_salesforce__lead_conversion_funnel") WHERE candidate_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY candidate_day ORDER BY n DESC,candidate_day LIMIT 8
